idle.name: hush_shade_idle
idle.action: idle stance: swaying slowly side to side, shoulders rising and falling, wisps of mist drifting off its body

move.name: hush_shade_move
move.action: shambling walk forward, dragging its long arms, body swaying

death.name: hush_shade_death
death.action: collapses to its knees and crumbles into a low pile of grey ash on the ground

attack.name: hush_shade_attack
attack.action: raises one long clawed arm high overhead, then slashes it down diagonally in front, and recovers to a hunched stance

hurt.name: hush_shade_hurt
hurt.action: flinches hard from a hit, body jerking backward, then recovers balance

moss_boar.desc: a wild boar beast with a shaggy dark-brown hide overgrown with green moss and small ferns on its back, big curved ivory tusks, small red eyes, stocky and angry, fantasy monster

idle.name: moss_boar_idle
idle.action: standing idle, breathing heavily, snorting, ears twitching

move.name: moss_boar_move
move.action: trotting forward at a steady run, legs galloping

hurt.name: moss_boar_hurt
hurt.action: flinches from a hit, head snapping aside, stumbling, then recovers

attack.name: moss_boar_attack
attack.action: lowers its head and paws the ground with a front hoof again and again, shaking its tusks, about to charge

death.name: moss_boar_death
death.action: staggers and topples over onto its side, lying still on the ground

petal_wisp.desc: a small floating flower spirit: a round glowing pink blossom bud body with large petal wings and two tiny leaf arms, a cute face with closed smiling eyes, sparkling pollen, hovering above the ground, fantasy creature

idle.name: petal_wisp_idle
idle.action: hovering in place, bobbing gently up and down, petal wings fluttering

hurt.name: petal_wisp_hurt
hurt.action: knocked back by a hit, spinning, petals ruffled, then steadies

attack.name: petal_wisp_attack
attack.action: curls all petals inward gathering light, then bursts the petals open and spits a seed forward

death.name: petal_wisp_death
death.action: petals wilt and fall off, it drops to the ground and lies there as a withered bud

stone_crab.desc: a big rock crab monster: a mossy grey boulder for a shell, two heavy stone pincers, six short armored legs, two small glowing yellow eyes peeking from under the shell, blue-grey stone and moss green, fantasy monster

idle.name: stone_crab_idle
idle.action: idle, pincers opening and closing slowly, eyes blinking

move.name: stone_crab_move
move.action: scuttling forward quickly on its many legs

attack.name: stone_crab_attack
attack.action: raises both heavy pincers high, then slams them down together in front

guard.name: stone_crab_guard
guard.action: pulls its legs and pincers in and hides completely under its boulder shell

hurt.name: stone_crab_hurt
hurt.action: flinches from a hit, shell rocking, pincers flailing, then recovers

death.name: stone_crab_death
death.action: flips over onto its back, legs curling up, and goes still

frost_wolf.desc: a fierce frost wolf with thick white fur, pale ice-blue tufts along its back and tail like icicles, glowing blue eyes, lean muscular body, snarling, fantasy monster

idle.name: frost_wolf_idle
idle.action: standing alert, breathing, tail swaying slightly, ears turning

move.name: frost_wolf_move
move.action: running forward in a fast gallop

attack.name: frost_wolf_attack
attack.action: crouches low on its front legs, then pounces forward with jaws wide open in a biting lunge, and lands

hurt.name: frost_wolf_hurt
hurt.action: yelps and flinches from a hit, stumbling sideways, then recovers

death.name: frost_wolf_death
death.action: collapses onto its side and lies still on the ground

maple_fox.desc: a mystical fox spirit with fiery orange-red fur, three big fluffy tails shaped like autumn maple leaves, white mask markings around glowing golden eyes, small and elegant, fantasy creature

idle.name: maple_fox_idle
idle.action: standing idle, three tails swaying like flames, ears flicking

attack.name: maple_fox_attack
attack.action: rears back and fans its three tails upward, then barks forward sharply with its mouth open, and settles

hurt.name: maple_fox_hurt
hurt.action: flinches from a hit, jumping back, fur bristling, then recovers

death.name: maple_fox_death
death.action: collapses and curls up on the ground, tails going limp

move.name: maple_fox_move
move.action: running forward lightly, tails streaming behind

field_scarecrow.desc: a living scarecrow monster: burlap sack head with a stitched mouth and two glowing orange eyes, wide torn straw hat, ragged patched farmer coat stuffed with straw, stick arms, holding a rusty pitchfork, autumn colors, fantasy monster

idle.name: field_scarecrow_idle
idle.action: standing idle, swaying loosely as if hanging on a pole, head tilting

move.name: field_scarecrow_move
move.action: walking forward with jerky loose limbs, straw shaking

attack.name: field_scarecrow_attack
attack.action: pulls the pitchfork back with both hands, then thrusts it far forward in a long stab, and pulls it back

hurt.name: field_scarecrow_hurt
hurt.action: flinches from a hit, straw bursting out, head wobbling, then recovers

death.name: field_scarecrow_death
death.action: falls apart into a heap of straw on the ground, the hat landing on top

bark_golem.desc: a hulking tree golem made of ancient gnarled bark and thick roots, moss and small glowing mushrooms on its broad shoulders, a hollow in its chest with a glowing green core, huge heavy wooden fists, small glowing green eyes, fantasy monster

idle.name: bark_golem_idle
idle.action: standing idle, heavy slow breathing, chest core pulsing

move.name: bark_golem_move
move.action: stomping forward with slow heavy steps

attack.name: bark_golem_attack
attack.action: slowly raises both huge fists high above its head, then smashes them down onto the ground in front with great force

hurt.name: bark_golem_hurt
hurt.action: flinches from a hit, bark chips flying, torso twisting, then recovers

death.name: bark_golem_death
death.action: its core dims, it falls to its knees and collapses into a pile of logs and bark

hollow_stag.desc: a colossal ancient stag deity turned colorless: a huge deer beast with pale ash-grey fur, enormous branching antlers like bare dead tree branches with a few last glowing white leaves, hollow glowing white eyes, tattered moss and roots hanging from its body, a dark crack across its chest, majestic and terrifying, monochrome grey palette, fantasy boss monster

idle.name: hollow_stag_idle
idle.action: standing idle, breathing slowly, head lowering and rising

move.name: hollow_stag_move
move.action: walking forward with slow majestic heavy steps

attack.name: hollow_stag_attack
attack.action: lowers its head and sweeps its huge antlers in a wide horizontal arc from one side to the other, then raises its head

stomp.name: hollow_stag_stomp
stomp.action: rears up on its hind legs, then slams both front hooves down onto the ground

roar.name: hollow_stag_roar
roar.action: lowers its head, then throws it back and bellows a long roar at the sky, body trembling

hurt.name: hollow_stag_hurt
hurt.action: staggers, head dropping low, front legs buckling, then recovers

death.name: hollow_stag_death
death.action: its legs give out, it slowly kneels and lies down on the ground, head lowering to rest

narae.desc: a brave teenage girl traveler with short ash-brown hair tied with a small red ribbon, a long scarf that is vivid red on one half and faded colorless grey on the other half, cream tunic with a short teal cape, brown boots, carrying a wooden staff with a small glowing paper lantern hanging from its tip, gentle determined face

run.name: narae_run
run.action: running forward at a brisk pace, holding the lantern staff in one hand, scarf trailing behind

attack.name: narae_attack
attack.action: swings the lantern staff in a wide horizontal arc in front of her, then returns to a ready stance; no magic effects, no glow

cheer.name: narae_cheer
cheer.action: raises the lantern staff high above her head with both hands and holds it there proudly, then lowers it

hurt.name: narae_hurt
hurt.action: getting hit: flinches and recoils backward from a blow, then recovers balance

npc_guide.desc: an old wandering scholar man with a long white beard, round spectacles, a wide-brimmed traveler hat, a big backpack full of rolled scrolls, long olive-green coat, holding a walking staff, kind face

npc_warrior.desc: a tall veteran knight man with short grey hair and a scar over one eye, heavy steel plate armor with a crimson tabard, a big kite shield on his back, both hands resting on a greatsword planted in the ground in front of him

npc_archer.desc: a ranger woman with a long green hooded cloak and a feathered cap, brown braid, leather bracers, a longbow and quiver on her back, a small white messenger bird on her shoulder

npc_mage.desc: an elegant sorceress woman with long violet hair, deep blue robe with golden star embroidery, a tall crystal-topped staff in one hand and an open spellbook in the other

npc_rogue.desc: a lean masked man in dark charcoal clothes with an ink-black scarf covering his lower face, a large calligraphy brush strapped on his back and two short blades at his belt, arms crossed, quiet and sharp

npc_miko.desc: a shrine maiden girl in a white kimono top and red hakama, long black hair with a cherry blossom hairpin, holding a paper purification wand, serene face

npc_keeper.desc: an old lighthouse keeper man in a navy pea coat and captain cap, bushy grey mustache, holding a big brass oil lantern, weathered kind face

npc_monk.desc: a calm bald buddhist monk man in saffron-orange and brown robes, wooden prayer beads around his neck, holding a wooden bell mallet, gentle smile

npc_scribe.desc: a small gentle woman scribe in moss-green robes with a leaf-shaped hair ornament in her brown bun, carrying a huge open book and a feather quill, ink-stained fingers, round glasses
